gen-silkscreen-gf-wix-madefor-display: Silkscreen keeps one line width throughout, each letter fenced off by space. Give Silkscreen generous size and let Wix Madefor Display, whose curve ends flare gently, sit quietly smaller beneath it.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans leaves every curved letter open at the end, so it feels approachable. And Silkscreen shows off horizontal bars that match its stems, spaced loosely, where Zalando Sans simply carries the words along.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: A lowercase a with no hairline strokes defines Silkscreen, which does its best work large and in few words. Zalando Sans Expanded keeps its c tips well clear of touching, with wide gaps along the row.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded opens its curves wide, giving a modern, businesslike look. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded is the open counterweight to Silkscreen, whose vinyl-cut sign-shop letters hold one line width.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Spaghetti-like lines with space around every letter make Silkscreen unmistakable. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, a sans-serif with a smooth path around each bend and a t whose crossbar matches its stem, glides down paragraphs.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Silkscreen is best at announcing, its single lines laid out like spaghetti with room around every letter. Zen Maru Gothic reads like one thread, never snagging on a closed bowl.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display fills its middle zone generously in every word, a friendly counterweight to Warnes and its neon-glass tubes. Neon glow up top, then a neutral, approachable voice below.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-rambla: Rambla sets its lowercase almost level with the capitals, which keeps text compact and clean. And Warnes, with zero stroke contrast and stretched tracking, stands out loudly, where Rambla simply talks.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-recursive: Ink strokes that taper off before touching, with zero contrast, mark Warnes at a glance. Recursive holds its thickness steady in every direction, so pair it with a heading well above its own size.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Warnes spreads ink strokes that taper off before touching across wide tracking, at its best in a few large words. Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified and steady, word after word.
